title: Fiscal Stimulus, Deposit Competition, and the Rise of Shadow Banking: Evidence from China
authors: Viral V. Acharya; Jun “QJ” Qian; Yang Su; Zhishu Yang
data_provenance_note: All inputs shipped except four CBRC-reported WMP balance variables in _1bankwmp_balance (balance, balance_a, wmpfloat, wmpguarantee), whose true values are disclosed for a 20% random sample of banks.
eligible_reason: Continuous treatment and a single date. The identifying variation is a bank's continuous exposure to Bank of China competition (boc = BOC branch share in the bank's markets, measured in 2010) interacted with a common post period (after = year > 2010, following the 2009-2010 stimulus): reghdfe <outcome> c.after#c.boc, absorb(bankfe year#provfe). Event-study versions use boc x year dummies. Branch opening (3_branchopen.do) and WMP offering (3_wmpoffer.do) regressions use the same continuous-exposure x single-post design at bank-city level, partly with PPML. No binary treatment with unit-specific adoption dates. Table with ivreghdfe instruments DAR with after x boc.
design_notes: Bank-year panel of the largest 25 banks and city commercial banks (2007-2015); bank-city panels for branch opening and WMP offering. Outcomes: WMPAsset_w (WMP balance/assets), DAR (deposit-to-asset), deposit rate, yields, ROA/ROE, LAR, size. FE: bank and province-by-year. Rollover analyses (4_rollover_*.do) use WMP due amounts as continuous regressors.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Single post period (year > 2010) common to all banks; treatment intensity is continuous.

specs.exclusion_reason: continuous treatment intensity (boc) x single post date
specs.notes: DAR, deposit rate, yield, ROA, LAR, size specifications have the same structure.
